parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activities in nM against target CHEMBL2971. Join assays on assay_id, target_dictionary on tid, molecule_dictionary on molregno, compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles, docs on activities.doc_id for pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback doi), and LEFT JOIN compound_records on activities.record_id for compound_key only. Filter: target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', target organism = 'Homo sapiens', canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL, at least one of pubmed_id or doi is non-null. Return DISTINCT rows of compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by all output columns.
